result.instructions: Tools for Smartplan, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the Smartplan account connected here."; "Review next week's shifts by location and job role."; "Compare planned and attended hours in last week's worklogs.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Smartplan data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smartplan_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smartplan_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smartplan_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. smartplan_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smartplan_list_accounts
tools.title: Show connected account
tools.description: Shows only the account selected during login, from the authenticated account list. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_get_account
tools.title: Get connected account
tools.description: Account settings and timezone for this connection's selected account. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_list_members
